title: FAQ Accordion Client Component — search + accordion + states
content:
Build the core client component for the FAQ page. A single `FAQAccordion` component that:

1. Receives `categories` data + `dict: FaqPageDict` + `locale` as props
2. Renders each category as a section with category name heading
3. Within each category, renders FAQ items as accordion rows:
   - Click question → expand answer (only ONE open at a time)
   - Click again or open another → collapse
4. Search input at top: real-time frontend filtering by question text (match current locale's question field)
5. URL hash support: on mount, check `window.location.hash` for `#faq-{id}`, auto-expand that question
6. Loading skeleton: show `animate-pulse` placeholders while data is null/undefined
7. Error state: show message + retry button if error prop is truthy
8. Empty state: show `dict.emptyState` when categories array is empty
9. Responsive: works on mobile (full-width, touch-friendly) and desktop

Sub-components:
- `FAQCategorySection` — category heading + its items
- Inline within FAQAccordion for accordion item rows

No data fetching here — data and fetch logic lives in the server page component (AF-003-C).

Use `"use client"` at top.
acceptance: Accordion shows categories as sections with category name
Click question → expand answer; click again → collapse
Only one question expanded at a time
Search input filters questions in real-time by current locale text
URL hash #faq-{id} auto-expands matching question on mount
Loading skeleton shows when data is null
Error state shows message with retry button
Empty state shows dict.emptyState when no categories
npm run typecheck && npm run lint pass
